title: Vuelta a España Stage 17: Brennan Romps to Record Victory for Visma-Lease a Bike
content:
Brennan kicks to his fifth, and team's seventh, victory of the Vuelta as Mas, Roglič, and GC rivals brace for crucial time trial.

Read the full article at Vuelta a España Stage 17: Brennan Romps to Record Victory for Visma-Lease a Bike on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
